name: discord
description: Discord cognitive agent — bot accounts, conversation, memory, proactive scheduling, media understanding, presence, and voice
author: sapphire

event_sources.name: discord_message
event_sources.label: Discord Message
event_sources.description: New message received in a Discord channel

task_fields.label: Bot Account
task_fields.help: Which Discord bot this daemon listens on. Only bots selected by an enabled daemon task are connected.

task_fields.label: Auto-reply in channel
task_fields.help: ON (default): AI's response posts back to the channel. OFF: listen-only mode.

schedule.name: morning_greeting
schedule.description: Post configured morning greetings (checks server-local hour each hour)

schedule.name: quiet_outreach
schedule.description: Proactive conversation starters when configured channels go quiet

schedule.name: sleep_goodnight
schedule.description: Goodnight messages and sleep state (checks sleep server-local hour with variable minute)

schedule.name: retention_purge
schedule.description: Daily purge of plugin data older than the Retention day limits

schedule.name: ambient_distill
schedule.description: Opt-in ambient chat distill into profile facts (honors profile.ambient_distill_interval_hours, default 1h)

settings.label: Task follow-ups
settings.help: Deliver due follow-ups from voice sessions, reminders, and commitments.

settings.label: Commitment follow-ups
settings.help: When someone says they will do something, follow up later.

settings.label: Reminder requests
settings.help: "Remind me in 5 minutes to…" queues a task and @mentions them when due.

settings.label: Learn birthdays
settings.help: Capture birthdays mentioned in chat onto user profiles.

settings.label: Birthday wishes
settings.help: Wish users a happy birthday on the day.

settings.label: Bulk birthday message
settings.help: One combined message when several birthdays land on the same day.

settings.label: Bulk birthday threshold
settings.help: Combine into one message at this many same-day birthdays.

settings.label: Memory
settings.help: ON (default): she builds per-user memory from Discord — facts, birthdays, and names, kept per bot account in the plugin's own database (never in her core Mind). OFF: no new capture and replies stop using stored facts; existing data stays until you Forget users below.

settings.label: Learn from ambient chat
settings.help: OFF (default): only explicit facts (/remember, tools, UI) and lightweight interests. ON: buffer member chat and periodically distill durable personal facts with an LLM into the plugin DB (never core Mind).

settings.label: Ambient distill interval (hours)
settings.help: How often distill may run per bot account. Default 1 hour. Cron checks every 15 minutes; values below 0.25 are clamped to 15 minutes.

settings.label: Min buffered messages before distill
settings.help: A person needs at least this many new buffered lines before the LLM distill runs for them.

settings.label: Max new facts per distill pass
settings.help: Upper bound on facts written for one person in a single distill pass.

settings.label: Relationship-aware social timing
settings.help: ON (default): familiarity and fondness softly scale organic replies, reactions, and outreach. Hard cooldowns and safety gates still win.

settings.label: Relationship policy strength
settings.help: How strongly relationship scores reshape social chances.

settings.label: Channel situation model
settings.help: Build a short-lived channel vibe snapshot (quiet / calm / lively / playful / heated) from recent messages for prompts and gates.

settings.label: Inject situation into prompts
settings.help: When situation is on, add a compact channel-situation block to reply instructions (data fence, not instructions).

settings.label: Intention competition (reply / react / silent)
settings.help: OFF (default): legacy organic % roll, then optional silent react on miss. ON: score reply vs react-only vs silence from situation + relationship (mentions/DMs still always reply).

settings.label: Situation-aware presence
settings.help: OFF (default): presence from sleep/quiet/cycling presets. ON: bias awake status/activity from the primary greeting channel's situation (sleep and quiet hours still override).

settings.label: Reply mode
settings.help: First gate before the LLM. Mentions only is the usual choice for public servers. Default also rolls Human/Bot organic reply chance on unaddressed channel messages.

options.label: Default — reply when addressed, plus organic chance
Mentions only — require @mention or name match
Reply to all — answer every allowed message

settings.label: Human organic reply chance (%)
settings.help: In Default reply mode only: percent chance (0-100) to reply to a human message that did not address her (@mention / name match). Mentions and DMs always reply. 0 = never chime in unprompted.

settings.label: Bot organic reply chance (%)
settings.help: In Default reply mode only: percent chance (0-100) to reply to an eligible bot message that did not address her. Still requires Bot-to-bot replies and allowlist/mode gates. Mentions bypass this roll. 0 = never.

settings.label: Respond to bot name (soft mention)
settings.help: Reply when a message contains the bot's name anywhere in the text, no @mention needed. OFF (default): only real @mentions count.

settings.label: Case-sensitive name match
settings.help: ON: the name must match capitalization exactly. OFF (default): any capitalization counts. Only applies when name match is on.

settings.label: Batch window (seconds)
settings.help: Collect rapid messages into one reply. Typing extends; questions halve.

settings.label: Strip thinking tags
settings.help: ON (default): removes <think> reasoning blocks from replies before posting. OFF: raw thinking text posts to the channel.

settings.label: Typing indicator
settings.help: ON (default): shows typing… before each message, paced like a human typing the reply (roughly 0.5-12 seconds by length). OFF: posts instantly with no indicator.

settings.label: Human pause
settings.help: Brief pause before sending, scaled to reply length.

settings.label: Read delay
settings.help: Wait as if reading the message before typing starts.

settings.label: Bot-to-bot replies
settings.help: ON (default): messages from other bots can get replies, governed by Bot reply mode. OFF: bot messages are always ignored. Humans are unaffected.

settings.label: Bot reply mode
settings.help: Which bots can get a reply — a bot must always address her (@mention, name, or replying to her last message). Never: ignore all bots. Allowlist (default): only bots checked in Allowlisted Bots below. Mentions only: any bot that addresses her.

settings.label: Human debate window (seconds)
settings.help: After a human addresses her, bots may volley reply-chains freely for this many seconds (a debate window). Minimum 60. Direct @mentions/name calls are always allowed regardless.

settings.label: Session silence timeout (seconds)
settings.help: A bot debate goes quiet after this many seconds without a volley — reply-chains stop until a human re-opens the window. Minimum 30.

settings.label: Safety cap (exchanges)
settings.help: Hard stop per debate: after this many replies to bots in a channel, further bot replies are blocked until a human re-engages her (which starts a fresh debate).

settings.label: Reactions enabled
settings.help: Let her react to messages with emoji on her own (sentiment-based). OFF: no autonomous reactions — reactions she writes into a reply herself still go through.

settings.label: Autonomous silent reactions
settings.help: React with an emoji without replying.

settings.label: Reaction chance (%)
settings.help: Chance (0-100%) she silently reacts to an incoming message with an emoji. Messages she isn't going to answer use a fixed 5% roll instead. 0 = never.

settings.label: Reaction cooldown (seconds)
settings.help: Minimum seconds between her self-initiated reactions in the same channel. 0 = no cooldown.

settings.label: React on reply path
settings.help: ON (default): she may also react to messages she's answering. OFF: react only to messages she's leaving alone.

settings.label: Read-only reactions
settings.help: React even on messages that will not get a reply.

settings.label: Message edits
settings.help: Master switch for editing her own messages after sending — typo fixes, [edit:] corrections, and random afterthoughts. OFF: messages are never edited once sent.

settings.label: Auto typos
settings.help: Occasionally send a typo, then fix it with an edit.

settings.label: Auto typo chance (%)
settings.help: Chance (0-100%) a reply goes out with a common misspelling, then gets edited to the fix seconds later. Skipped when answering a question; needs Message edits ON.

settings.label: Typo fix delay min (seconds)
settings.help: Shortest wait (seconds) before the typo-fix edit lands. Values under 0.5 are treated as 0.5.

settings.label: Typo fix delay max (seconds)
settings.help: Longest wait (seconds) before the typo-fix edit. If set below the min, the two swap.

settings.label: Smart quote-replies
settings.help: ON (default): quote-reply when context calls for it — always for questions, usually in busy channels, rarely in DMs, never on jokes or images. OFF: plain messages, no quote header.

settings.label: Random post-send edits
settings.help: About 4% of replies get a human touch after sending: a subtle typo fixed by edit, or an afterthought ('lol', 'actually') edited in 2-5 seconds later. Needs Message edits ON.

settings.label: Morning greetings
settings.help: ON: posts a morning greeting to each Greeting Channel at the greeting hour, written through the normal persona pipeline. OFF (default): no morning posts.

settings.label: Greeting hour (server local)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local time) when the morning greeting posts. Also the sleep-schedule wake hour and the start of the birthday-wish window.

settings.label: AI-generated greeting
settings.help: ON (default): the AI writes each greeting, guided by the Greeting instructions. OFF: posts the Greeting instructions text verbatim (or the fallback if blank).

settings.label: Greeting instructions
settings.help: With AI-generated greeting ON: instructions guiding the AI's greeting (blank = built-in default). With it OFF: this exact text is posted instead.

settings.label: Greeting fallback
settings.help: Posted as-is when the AI can't generate a greeting, or when AI-generated greeting is OFF and no instructions are set.

settings.label: Quiet outreach
settings.help: Start a conversation when configured channels go quiet.

settings.label: Outreach after quiet (minutes)
settings.help: Minutes of channel silence before she may start a conversation in a Greeting Channel. Checked every 15 minutes; skipped during sleep and just before the greeting hour.

settings.label: Sleep schedule
settings.help: ON: posts a goodnight at the sleep hour, then sleeps until the greeting hour — presence shows sleeping, non-mention chat is ignored, and mentions are buffered (enough mentions force a temporary wake). OFF (default): always awake.

settings.label: Sleep hour (server local)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local time) when sleep starts; runs until the greeting hour (wraps past midnight). Set equal to the greeting hour to disable the window.

settings.label: AI-generated goodnight
settings.help: ON (default): the AI writes the goodnight, guided by the Goodnight instructions. OFF: posts the Goodnight instructions text verbatim (or the fallback if blank).

settings.label: Goodnight instructions
settings.help: With AI-generated goodnight ON: instructions guiding the AI's goodnight (blank = built-in default). With it OFF: this exact text is posted instead.

settings.label: Goodnight fallback
settings.help: Posted as-is when the AI can't generate a goodnight, or when AI-generated goodnight is OFF and no instructions are set.

settings.label: Forced-wake mentions
settings.help: Mentions while asleep that force a wake-up.

settings.label: Forced-wake window (minutes)
settings.help: How long she stays awake and answers after repeated mentions wake her during sleep (default 30). Afterwards she sleeps again until the greeting hour.

settings.label: Birthday wish spread end hour
settings.help: Birthday wishes post at a per-person random time between the greeting hour and this hour (0-23, server local) instead of all at once.

settings.label: Wake replay max
settings.help: On waking (at the greeting hour), answer up to this many mentions she slept through, per channel. 0 = don't answer missed pings.

settings.label: Awake status
settings.help: Discord status shown while awake: Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb, or Invisible.

settings.label: Default activity
settings.help: Activity line under the bot's name while awake — 'playing: chess', 'listening: lo-fi', 'watching: the server', 'competing: trivia', or plain text for a custom status. Empty = none. Ignored while cycling is on.

settings.label: Quiet / sleep status
settings.help: Status shown during quiet hours and while asleep.

settings.label: Cycle activities
settings.help: ON: while awake, rotate a random activity from the checked presets plus Custom activities every cycle interval. OFF (default): keep the single Default activity.

settings.label: Cycle interval (seconds)
settings.help: Seconds between activity changes while cycling. Minimum 60.

settings.label: Custom activities
settings.help: Extra activities added to the cycling pool alongside the checked presets. Same format as Default activity; enter '-' for a no-activity turn.

settings.label: Allow DMs
settings.help: ON (default): the bot replies to direct messages. OFF: she won't reply to DMs (they are still stored in the plugin database, and scheduled reminders she owes someone may still deliver by DM).

settings.label: Reply cooldown (seconds)
settings.help: Minimum seconds between replies in the same channel, DMs included (default 30). 0 = no limit. This is the only throttle on the reply pipeline.

settings.label: Proactive cooldown (hours)
settings.help: Minimum hours between proactive posts of the same kind (greeting, outreach, goodnight, birthday) in one channel. Reminder and commitment follow-ups bypass this.

settings.label: Quiet hours
settings.help: Presence only: during the quiet window her status switches to the Quiet / sleep status. Replies and proactive posts still send — use the Sleep schedule to actually go quiet.

settings.label: Quiet start (server local hour)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local) quiet hours begin. Start later than end wraps past midnight; start equal to end disables.

settings.label: Quiet end (server local hour)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local) quiet hours end. Example: start 22, end 7 covers overnight.

settings.label: Media pipeline
settings.help: ON: images and GIFs posted in chat are detected, stored, and described by the Vision LLM below so her replies can reference them. OFF: attachments are ignored. Does not affect GIF replies.

settings.label: Image understanding
settings.help: Caption images/GIFs with the vision endpoint so replies can reference them.

settings.label: Vision timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long to wait for the vision model before giving up (default 30). On timeout the image gets a filename-only description.

settings.label: Vision GIF mode
settings.help: First frame (default): the GIF's first frame is sent to the vision model as a PNG — works everywhere. Whole GIF sends the raw animated file as-is; only useful if your endpoint accepts animated GIFs.

settings.label: Vision debug logging
settings.help: Logs every vision call (provider detection, request start/success/failure) to Traces and the app log. OFF (default): only fallbacks and errors are traced.

settings.label: GIF replies
settings.help: ON: she can reply with real GIFs — she writes [gif:search terms] or calls the send-GIF tool and it's swapped for a GIF from your provider. Requires a GIF API key.

settings.label: GIF API key
settings.help: API key for the selected GIF provider. GIF replies stay off until this is set, even with the toggle on.

settings.label: GIF provider
settings.help: Which service her GIF searches use: Klipy, Giphy, or Tenor. The API key must match the provider.

settings.label: GIF content filter
settings.help: Safety level for GIF search results: Off (unfiltered) to High (strictest). Applies the same direction on Klipy, Giphy, and Tenor.

settings.label: Voice
settings.help: Let her join voice channels

settings.label: Voice mode
settings.help: What she does in a channel

settings.label: Transcription
settings.help: Archive what she hears as text

settings.label: Speaking
settings.help: Let her talk back out loud

settings.label: Turn cues
settings.help: Tick while she thinks, ding on barge-in

settings.label: Emergency stop
settings.help: Kill switch — overrides all voice settings

settings.label: Addressing mode
settings.help: When she treats speech as meant for her

settings.label: Name aliases
settings.help: Extra names that count as hers (sapph, saphire...)

settings.label: Retention purge
settings.help: OFF (default): nothing is ever purged. ON: a daily purge (4:30 AM server time) deletes plugin rows older than the day limits below — enabling this is a conscious choice; the first run on a long-lived database deletes everything beyond the windows.

settings.label: Keep messages (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes the plugin's stored copies of Discord messages older than this many days (default 90). 0 = keep forever. Nothing is deleted on Discord itself.

settings.label: Keep traces (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes decision traces (the Traces view) older than this many days (default 14). 0 = keep forever.

settings.label: Keep transcripts (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes voice-channel transcripts older than this many days (default 30). 0 = keep forever.
